prompt: Pearl bakes a giant birthday cake
title: Big Birthday Cake
irony: Pearl bakes a giant cake to keep the party big, but each yes-to-more gives it away piece by piece, so the party is saved only when she shares the whole cake in small slices.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Morning sun fills Pearl's big kitchen where a giant pink cake towers on the table.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Teddy counts candles for Benny's birthday while Pearl says yes to each new topping.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Constance steps in with a baking rule and taps the tall cake as it starts to wobble.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The friends gather round the giant cake and chant its name with sticky hands.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Pearl piles on more frosting for Benny and the tall cake leans sideways fast.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The giant cake slides, plops frosting on Pearl's nose, and Benny giggles loud.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The friends hold the wobbly cake steady and chant its name once more.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Pearl sighs in the warm kitchen and admits each yes tips the cake.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Pearl smiles, plans neat small slices, and asks Benny to hand each guest a plate.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Pearl cuts the giant cake and hands each guest a sweet slice as candles glow.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Morning sun fills the kitchen again as empty plates shine and Benny hugs Pearl.
